schemaDatasetDescription: Reviewed Jeffco Public Schools dates for 2026–27, including first day, last day, breaks, teacher staff development days, potential snow make-up days, legal holidays, translated PDFs, and last-day early dismissal.
heroSummary: Jeffco Public Schools begins the 2026–27 school year on Wednesday, August 19, 2026, and the last day is Thursday, May 27, 2027. District-run PK–12 schools dismiss 2.5 hours early on the last day; charter schools set their own dismissal schedules. Fall Break is October 12–13, Thanksgiving Break is November 23–27, Winter Break is December 21–January 5, and Spring Break is March 22–26.
heroFactChips: Potential snow make-up days: Feb 12, Mar 29, Apr 30
calendarNotes: Jeffco’s 2026–27 family calendar lists February 12, March 29, and April 30 as teacher staff development days and potential snow make-up days. The PDF also notes that the last-day early dismissal schedule does not apply to charter schools.

sourceReviewSummary: Verified against the Jeffco calendar page and the official 2026–27 English family calendar PDF. Last reviewed by MySchoolDates on August 4, 2026.
sourceReviewDetails: Reviewed against the Jeffco calendar page and the official 2026–27 English family calendar PDF.
The official PDF resource is labeled EN_Final_5.22.26; the page does not treat that label as a confirmed document modification date.
The PDF lists 79 first-semester student contact days and 92 second-semester student contact days.
The PDF marks October 13, February 12, March 29, and April 30 as teacher staff development days.
The last-day dismissal notice says the schedule does not apply to charter schools and tells charter families to contact their schools directly.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Jeffco Public Schools start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Jeffco Public Schools begins the 2026–27 school year on Wednesday, August 19, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Jeffco in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day is Thursday, May 27, 2027. District-run PK–12 schools dismiss 2.5 hours early; charter schools set their own dismissal schedules.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Jeffco’s winter and spring breaks in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 5, 2027, and Spring Break runs March 22–26, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: What are Jeffco’s potential snow make-up days in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Jeffco lists February 12, March 29, and April 30 as teacher staff development days and potential snow make-up days. Families should check district updates before assuming students will have those days off.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded Jeffco calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The .ics file is a one-time import and will not automatically update if Jeffco Public Schools revises the calendar.
